title: Add SWE-1.5 LLM Support Everywhere
description: The swe-1-5 llm should be supported everywhere. Need to identify all places where LLM models are configured or referenced and ensure swe-1-5 is included in the available options.
summary: Successfully added swe-1-5 LLM support everywhere in the codebase. The swe-1-5 model was already included in the VSCode extension and documentation, but was missing from the Go repo's AllowedLLMs list. Added swe-1-5 to the AllowedLLMs array in ./semio-repo/cli/main.go, which automatically enables the --swe-1-5 flag for all relevant CLI commands (ticket open, ticket reopen, goal open, goal reopen). The change has been tested and confirmed working.
